packages.title: A reminder line with no tap is information: no «desactivado» for TalkBack on the card's collapsed row, and no outline on the task's chip
brief: Round 2 of plan 3. Round 1's P259 made a task given to someone else read only «Recordatorio para Marta», with no tap and no choices, and drew every reminder line with no tap as information at full contrast. Review B (.claude/ux-review/runs/2026-10-22-changes/verify-p3-r1-B.md) found UX-2024, UX-2027 and UX-2028 fixed, and UX-2025 fixed on screen with one gap left. It also found one regression. Both problems are about a line with no tap that still looks or sounds like a control. Both touch only how such a line is drawn and announced: no copy, no logic, no ARB change.

UX-2025 (S2, partly fixed, failed once): TalkBack still hears the capture card's collapsed row as switched off. What P259 did: `_reminderLine()` (App/lib/widgets/capture_review_editor.dart:411-441) now builds Marta's line with no tap and no chevron. Its Semantics has `button: onTap != null` and `enabled: onTap != null` (:418-419). Why it failed: a line with no tap now gets an enabled state that is off, so TalkBack says «Recordatorio para Marta, desactivado». A first-time user hears that as «the reminder is off», which is the switched-off control the brief ruled out. Before P259 this line always had a tap, so the disabled state is new. The tester's check (App/test/reminder_plan_sheet_test.dart:6704, group 'P259 · personal reminders') asserts only `isButton: false, hasTapAction: false`, so it passed. Fix, in that Semantics only: `button: line.onTap != null` and `enabled: line.onTap == null ? null : widget.enabled`. A line that has a tap stays a button, and TalkBack announces it as disabled while the result is saving, as it does for the date line (:384-385, UX-462). A line without a tap is plain text, with no enabled state. Keep these as they are: `final onTap = widget.enabled ? line.onTap : null;`, `excludeSemantics`, `onTap: onTap`, the ListTile, its key, and the chevron rule (`trailing: onTap == null ? null : …`). Update the doc comment above it (:406-410): TalkBack reads a line with no tap as plain text, with no enabled state.

UX-2034 (S1, regression R1B-1 from P259): the task's chip still looks tappable when it has no tap. What P259 did: when the line has no tap, `ReminderChip` (App/lib/widgets/reminder_control.dart:628-637) draws a plain `Chip`, with the label in `onSurface`. Why it fails: that Chip keeps the theme's outlined border (`chipTheme.side: BorderSide(color: scheme.outline)`, App/lib/theme/app_theme.dart:153-156) and the same box as the chips that do something. So on the task's page «Recordatorio para Ana» looks like a button, and a tap does nothing (render reminders/task-line.given-to-someone.es.light.1x). The newcomer reads a dead tap as a fault. Fix, on that `Chip` only: add `side: BorderSide.none` and `backgroundColor: Colors.transparent`. Keep its key, `avatarBoxConstraints`, the bell avatar, the label with its ConstrainedBox and `maxLines: 10`, and `labelStyle` in `onSurface`. I chose a borderless Chip over an icon and text in a Row for two reasons: the words stay exactly where the tappable chip's words sit, and the existing helpers (`chipColor`, `chipWords`, App/test/reminder_plan_sheet_test.dart:6315-6340) keep working. Leave the `ActionChip` branch as it is, with the theme's outline. The fix covers every chip with no tap: a task given to someone else, an archived project's «Sin recordatorio: proyecto archivado», and an account without edit rights. Update the comment above (:625-626): a line with no tap is information, so it's drawn with no outline and at full contrast. How this fits D9 (UX-2032, open): if the owner chooses (b), a reader's chip gets a tap, and with it the ActionChip's outline. Nothing more would need to change.

Previews (App/test/ux_previews/reminders_previews.dart, `planLine` 'given-to-someone', :341-356): change only the end of the description, to «… so the chip reads only «Recordatorio para Ana», at full contrast and with no outline, with no value and no tap.» Re-render reminders/ and check task-line.given-to-someone (es 1×, ca 2×): the reminder line has no outline, while the chips above it, such as «Matemáticas», keep theirs.

Tests: as far as I know, the change breaks no existing test. The full-contrast and no-button checks at App/test/reminder_plan_sheet_test.dart:6505-6518 and :7140-7146 still hold. Don't edit the check at :6704 yourself: ux-tester adds the enabled-state check. If anything else breaks, say which test and why in your notes.

Not yours: App/lib/widgets/reminder_plan_sheet.dart (P265, which runs beside this one), the ARB catalogs (no copy changes), App/lib/screens/task_detail_screen.dart, `ReminderControl` and everything else in reminder_control.dart, and Backend/.
acceptance: Capture card, ES 1× on 360×800, a result of three tasks. Marta's timed draft (d2) is in «Equipo», given to Marta, with `reminder_minutes: 60`. The semantics node of its collapsed line «Recordatorio para Marta» is not a button, has no tap action, and has no enabled state (`hasEnabledState: false`), so TalkBack can't read it as «desactivado».

In the same kind of result, a personal timed draft has a collapsed reminder line with a tap. Its node is a button, enabled, with a tap action. While the result is saving (the card's `enabled` is false), the same node is still a button, not enabled, with no tap action, as the date line is (UX-462).

Task detail, ES 1× on 360×800, «Presentar el proyecto» in «Equipo», given to Marta and carrying `reminderMinutes: 60`. The `ReminderChip` draws a `Chip`, not an `ActionChip`, with `side` = BorderSide.none and a transparent background. Its label «Recordatorio para Marta» is drawn in `colorScheme.onSurface` at full alpha, with the bell. Its semantics node is not a button, has no tap action and has no enabled state. A tap opens no sheet and leaves the task's reminder values unchanged.
The same task at CA 2× on 360×800: «Recordatori per a Marta» is whole and unclipped beside its bell, with no outline, and no overflow is reported.
An archived project's chip «Sin recordatorio: proyecto archivado» (ES 1×) is drawn the same way: no outline, transparent, full contrast, no tap.

Unchanged: a «Todos» task in «Equipo» keeps an `ActionChip` with the theme's outline (`colorScheme.outline`), and it opens the reminder sheet. A task in a project muted on this phone keeps an `ActionChip` «Sin recordatorio: proyecto silenciado», and it opens «Novedades del proyecto».
`flutter analyze --no-pub` is clean. The render reminders/task-line.given-to-someone (es 1×, ca 2×) shows the reminder line with no outline.
deviceChecks: TalkBack, on a physical phone or the TaskFlow_Review emulator (say which): on the capture card's collapsed row for a draft given to Marta, and on that task's page, «Recordatorio para Marta» is read as text, with no «botón» and no «desactivado».

packages.title: Shared task's reminder sheet: a thin line under «solo para ti» marks where the scrolling choices start
brief: Round 2 of plan 3. UX-2035 (S1, regression R1D-1 from P261, verify-p3-r1-D.md). What P261 did, and rightly (UX-2026 is fixed): on a shared task, the reminder sheet holds the title «Recordatorio» and «Estos avisos son solo para ti.» (`_JustYou`) in a fixed Column. The choices scroll under them, in `Flexible(child: choices(withTitle: false))` (App/lib/widgets/reminder_plan_sheet.dart:750-763). What it broke: before, the title scrolled away with the rows, so a sheet that opened part-way down its list looked part-way down. Now the sheet can open scrolled to a plan (UX-1810's `Scrollable.ensureVisible`, :182, :243, :264), mostly at 2×. When it does, the rows slide under the fixed header with no edge. In the render reminders/sheet.shared.es.light.2x, «Hasta la fecha límite» sits directly under «para ti.», and nothing shows that «Desactivado» and «Elegir hora del aviso» are above.

Fix, in the `widget.shared` branch only: between `const _JustYou(),` and `Flexible(child: choices(withTitle: false)),`, add `const Divider(height: 1, key: ValueKey('reminder-sheet-header-edge')),`. Show it always. The reviewer offered either this or showing the line only while the list is scrolled. I settled on always: it needs no state and no scroll listener, and at the top it reads as the header's edge. Update the comment above the branch (:748-749) to say that a thin line marks where the choices scroll under the title and the note. No new copy and no other spacing changes.

Keep these as they are: the title and its padding; `_JustYou` (its padding 24/0/24/8, its key `reminder-plan-just-you`, its style); `choices()` and its padding; the plan section's own `Divider(height: 17)` (:533); the `ensureVisible` logic; and the personal-task branch (`choices(withTitle: true)`), which gets no new line.

Tests: the UX-1904 check `expect(inSheet(find.byType(Divider)), findsNothing)` (App/test/reminder_plan_sheet_test.dart:1862) is for a personal task and must keep passing. A test in the group 'P261 · D8, UX-2026, UX-2031' (:7160) or 'P256 · D6' may count the shared sheet's dividers or measure the gap under the note exactly. If one does, update it for this one line and say which in your notes. `expectJustUnderTitle` (the note no more than 16 dp under the title) is unaffected.

Previews: don't edit App/test/ux_previews/reminders_previews.dart (P264 changes it beside you). The sheet.shared description still holds. Re-render reminders/ and check sheet.shared (es 1×, es 2×, ca 2×). A line must separate «solo para ti.» / «només per a tu.» from the first choice in view: «Desactivado» at 1×, «Hasta la fecha límite» / «Fins al termini» at 2×.
Not yours: App/lib/widgets/reminder_control.dart and App/lib/widgets/capture_review_editor.dart (P264), the one-tap list's note in `_pickFrom`, the ARB catalogs, and Backend/.
acceptance: The reminder sheet of a «Todos» task in «Equipo» (shared) that carries a plan, so the sheet opens scrolled to that plan, at ES 2× and CA 2× on 360×800. One `Divider` keyed `reminder-sheet-header-edge`, 1 dp high, sits below «Estos avisos son solo para ti.» / «Aquests avisos són només per a tu.», within 8 dp of the note's bottom. Every choice row that can be hit in view, «Hasta la fecha límite» / «Fins al termini» among them, has its top at or below the divider's bottom.
On the same sheet, scrolling the choices up or down by 200 dp leaves the divider, the title and the note where they were.
The reminder sheet of a shared «Todos» task with no plan, opened at its top, ES 1× on 360×800. From top to bottom: «Recordatorio», «Estos avisos son solo para ti.», the divider, then «Desactivado».
The reminder sheet of a personal task (UX-1904's «Presentar el proyecto» due today, ES 1×) has no `reminder-sheet-header-edge` and no `Divider`, as before.
There is no new string, and `flutter analyze --no-pub` is clean. The renders reminders/sheet.shared (es 1×, es 2×, ca 2×) show the line between the note and the first choice.
